# DeepKOALA detailed-output fixture

`detailed.csv` is a small synthetic fixture based only on the documented detailed-output column
contract reviewed on 2026-07-14. It is not an output generated by DeepKOALA and contains no model,
database, KEGG payload, protein sequence, or redistributed third-party data.

The fixture exercises the documented `name`, `predict_label`, `probability`, `threshold`, and
`annotate` fields plus optional `start` and `end` domain coordinates.
